verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party AI that generates or improves prompts, flows, or test cases from a description. The context-hub MCP index and the AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md scaffolding only support the user's own external coding agent, which is adjacent help rather than the platform's own AI. Pipecat Evals runs conversations the user writes; it does not generate them, and Flows derives function metadata deterministically from docstrings, not via AI authoring.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform's own AI helps me author agents — generating or improving prompts, flows, and test cases from a description
